materials.en: Sourceedits: content items, at most 256 items.

materials.zh: Voiceover：文字，不超过 240 个字符。

materials.en: Voiceovermode: text. Explicit current-production voice choice; no original-mix fallback..
Soundtrackmode: text. Independent current music, or explicitly no music. Voice is a separate choice. Original music/SFX recovery is not certified..
Music: text, up to 240 characters. Input-root relative full-length licensed music; required for external-music, empty for none. No automatic looping or silent music tail..
materials.zh: Music：文字，不超过 240 个字符。

dependencies.en: The package declares a Python and Node.js host. Check its dependency lock for supported versions and any additional rendering tools.
dependencies.zh: 模板声明使用 Python 和 Node.js。具体工具与版本以下载包为准。

dependencies.en: Use the package dependency lock and setup/check instructions. Check existing tools first, install only missing requirements and verify a preview.
dependencies.zh: 按下载包的依赖锁和 setup/check 说明检查已有工具，只补齐缺项，并验证预览。

en: Fixed landscape animation using the listed public text/display-data/palette slots, current narration and independently supplied licensed music.
zh: Fixed landscape animation using the listed public text/display-data/palette slots, current narration and independently supplied licensed music.

en: The documented output is 1920 × 1080, 60 fps; default demo duration is 76 seconds.
Use the actual package parameter bounds; extra materials do not automatically create extra scenes.
Changing the scene order or engine; the frozen original source and timeline remain authoritative.

Automatic replacement of product images/videos or brand paths/marks: no declared media import slot in this candidate. Preserve fixed demonstration visuals only when they are relevant; otherwise this route is not suitable.
zh: 已声明输出为 1920 × 1080，60 fps；默认样片 76 秒。
按实际包的参数边界制作；增加素材不会自动增加场景。

capabilities.en: Optional services require a live catalog, template slot and account check before they can be confirmed.
capabilities.zh: 配套服务需核对官网实时能力、模板槽位和账号权限后才能确认。
